Likely a public school, so staff is a state employee (国家工作人员). He misappropriated public funds (挪用公款) from cafeteria account to his mother, using forged seals. This is classic "挪用公款". In examples, they used "挪用公款" for similar. Also sometimes "挪用资金" used when not state employee? Example: "林某某利用其担任漳州市某公司业务员的职务便利，采用收取客户货款不上缴的手段，共挪用公司货款人民币70920元" answer: "挪用资金". That was not state employee. Here is state employee, so "挪用公款". Also self-surrender, but that doesn't affect charge. So answer single: 挪用公款.

Check if any other crimes like "受贿"? He didn't receive bribes, he just transferred. So only "挪用公款". Return format: [罪名]挪用公款<eoa>
